title: Proof of Loss and Payment Timing — NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own)
content:
## Proof of loss for NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own)

The insured must send a signed and sworn proof of loss for each coverage claimed.

**Deadline.** A proof of loss is accepted only when it is received no later than the tier's proof-of-loss period, in calendar days, after the date of loss, counted by adding the days to the date of loss on the calendar, a receipt on the last day qualifying. The date of loss is the one recorded on the claim, identified by its claim number.

**Adjuster's report in lieu.** Tidemark may accept the adjuster's report signed and sworn by the insured in lieu of a proof of loss.

**Late proof.** A proof of loss received after the deadline is not accepted and the coverage is denied as Proof of Loss Not Timely unless FEMA has issued a written extension of the deadline for the event, recorded on the claim.

**Payment timing.** The loss is payable within the tier's payment period after an accepted proof of loss, or within the tier's payment period after an adjuster's report signed in lieu of it (both in calendar days). A payment is never issued for more than the amount sworn on the proof of loss for that coverage.

| Proof of loss received | FEMA written extension recorded on the claim | Result |
|---|---|---|
| On or before the last day of the period | — | Accepted |
| After the last day | Yes | Treated under the extension |
| After the last day | No | Not accepted; coverage denied as Proof of Loss Not Timely |

*Hypothetical boundary (abstract dates).* The last day is found by adding the period's days to the date of loss on the calendar. A sworn proof of loss received on that last day is accepted; one received the next day is not, unless a FEMA extension for the event is recorded on the claim.
